name: Out-of-Core GPU-Accelerated Multi-Resolution Rendering Framework
definition: A rendering framework consisting of three main procedures: Caching, Prefetching, and Rendering, designed to handle large-scale volumes by managing data movement between storage, RAM, and GPU.
summary: This framework renders large volumetric datasets exceeding GPU memory by managing disk-to-VRAM transfers via caching and prefetching, while using adaptive multi-resolution micro-models to adjust detail based on viewer distance.
